questions.prompt: A loader decodes its config, then establishes C2. What is its third stage called?
Why does the loader assemble its strings at runtime instead of writing them as literals?

options.a: So static string scans miss the keywords and URLs

questions.prompt: Stage 3 executes whatever the C2 returns. What do you do with that line?

options.a: Execute it to see what tasking comes back
options.b: Read it to establish intent — never run it
